<a id="a-law-along-one-run-under-a-relation--沿一个运行在一个关系之下的规律"></a>
# A law along one run, under a relation

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-law-through-a-projection-along-one-run` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11 · [record](a-law-through-a-projection-along-one-run.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Under an equivalence, a law admits a run's steps up to a step exactly where steps alike under it, by the same move, end alike, and failure persists. Projection, changing coupling and fixed conditions are its readings; the image is exact exactly where alike configurations match steps.

<a id="exact-statement--确切陈述"></a>
## Exact statement

One law along a run, up to an equivalence: some process going alike under it admits a run's steps before a step exactly where any two of them alike under it, by the same move, end alike (Run.law_under_iff), with the record read under it as witness and failure persisting. Its readings are corollaries: through a projection, the relation of equal images (Run.ConsistentThrough is consistency under that relation, and Run.law_through_iff is proved from Run.law_under_iff), where the record is the least candidate and the identity gives the history law; through coupling that changes along the run, with dependences read off the configuration; and through fixed conditions, the instance whose dependences do not change, matching Web.AlikeThrough. Exactness of the image is a law of the whole process, kept beside them.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Where a relation is an equivalence, some process going alike under it admits a run's steps before a step exactly where any two of them from related configurations, by the same move, reach related configurations. The witness is the record read under the relation; the forward direction needs no equivalence. (`Becoming.Run.ConsistentUnder`, `Becoming.Run.recordUnder`, `Becoming.Run.recordUnder_steps`, `Becoming.Run.recordUnder_goAlike`, `Becoming.Run.law_under_iff`)
2. Consistency up to a step holds at every earlier step, so once no such process admits the steps it admits none later; a process going alike under the relation makes every run consistent; through equal projections the criterion is the one along one run through a projection. (`Becoming.Run.ConsistentUnder.earlier`, `Becoming.Run.no_law_under_later`, `Becoming.Run.consistentUnder_of_goAlikeUnder`, `Becoming.Run.consistentUnder_eq_iff`)
3. Some determined process on a description admits a run's steps before a step, read through the projection, exactly where any two of them from configurations alike under it, by the same move, reach configurations alike under it. The witness is the record read through the projection: it admits those steps, every process admitting them admits its steps, and it is determined exactly where they are consistent. (`Becoming.Run.ConsistentThrough`, `Becoming.Run.recordThrough`, `Becoming.Run.stepsThrough_record`, `Becoming.Run.record_least`, `Becoming.Run.record_determined_iff`, `Becoming.Run.law_through_iff`)
4. Consistency up to a step holds at every earlier step, so where no determined process on the description admits the steps before a step, none admits them before any later one. Through the identity at every step the criterion is Becoming.Unfolding's consistency of a history, of which exists_law_iff is the law. (`Becoming.Run.ConsistentThrough.earlier`, `Becoming.Run.no_law_later`, `Becoming.Run.consistent_id_iff`)
5. Where configurations alike under the projection go alike, every run is consistent through it at every step; the converse fails: a run staying at one configuration of a process allowing every step is consistent through the identity, and the process does not go alike. Switching's run is inconsistent through the projection; its missing state law is Switching.no_state_law of Becoming.Mechanism. (`Becoming.Run.consistent_of_goAlike`, `Becoming.Constant.process`, `Becoming.Constant.run`, `Becoming.Constant.consistent`, `Becoming.Constant.not_goAlike`, `Becoming.Switching.inconsistent`, `Becoming.Switching.no_state_law`)
6. With dependences read off the configuration, two configurations are alike in what a formation couples into when the levels at each, through the dependence it has there, admit it alike and the conditions it observes stand alike. This is an equivalence, so some process going alike in it admits a run's steps before a step exactly where the occasions it couples alike, by the same move, lead to occasions it couples alike. Fixed conditions are the instance. (`Becoming.Dependence.AdmitsAt`, `Becoming.Dependence.AlikeAt`, `Becoming.Dependence.alikeAt_equivalence`, `Becoming.Dependence.conditions_alikeAt_iff`, `Becoming.Run.consistent_conditions_iff`, `Becoming.Run.law_through_dependence_iff`)
7. Along a run this is the relation between two steps each read through its own step's dependence. Web.AlikeThrough read at one step, between the levels standing at two steps, is the coupling with the dependence of that step held fixed; where the dependences at the two steps compared are that step's, it is the changing coupling. (`Becoming.Web.AlikeAcross`, `Becoming.Dependence.alikeAt_iff_alikeAcross`, `Becoming.Dependence.fixedAt`, `Becoming.Dependence.alikeThrough_iff_fixedAt`, `Becoming.Web.admits_own_iff`, `Becoming.Web.alikeAcross_iff_alikeThrough`)
8. Consistency reads a relation only on the run's configurations up to the step, so where a formation's dependences up to it are those of one step, the run is consistent under the changing coupling exactly where it is under the coupling fixed at that step. (`Becoming.Dependence.SameFor`, `Becoming.Dependence.admitsAt_fixedAt_iff`, `Becoming.Dependence.Unchanged`, `Becoming.Run.consistentUnder_congr`, `Becoming.Run.consistent_unchanged_iff`)
9. With fixed conditions, two configurations are alike in what a formation couples into when their levels admit it alike and the conditions it observes stand alike; this is an equivalence, exactly Web.AlikeThrough on the runs read through the conditions, between two runs at a step and between two steps of one run. So some process going alike in what the formation couples into admits a run's steps exactly where the occasions it couples alike, by the same move, lead to occasions it couples alike. (`Becoming.Conditions.AdmitsAt`, `Becoming.Conditions.AlikeAt`, `Becoming.Conditions.alikeAt_equivalence`, `Becoming.Conditions.alikeThrough_iff`, `Becoming.Conditions.alikeAt_iff_alikeThrough`, `Becoming.Run.law_through_coupling_iff`)
10. In Unseen the process is determined, and a formation depending on one level and observing nothing couples the run's first two steps alike while by the same move they lead to configurations it couples apart: the level it does not couple into decides, and no law holds at its coupling along the run. Observing that level, the run is consistent at every step. (`Becoming.Unseen.process`, `Becoming.Unseen.level`, `Becoming.Unseen.conditions`, `Becoming.Unseen.state`, `Becoming.Unseen.run`, `Becoming.Unseen.determined`, `Becoming.Unseen.admits`, `Becoming.Unseen.not_admits_zero`, `Becoming.Unseen.inconsistent`, `Becoming.Unseen.no_law`, `Becoming.Unseen.observing`, `Becoming.Unseen.first_apart`, `Becoming.Unseen.consistent_observing`)
11. In Changing, one level rising by one each step, the process is determined. A dependence dissolving across the first step leaves the run consistent at every step under the changing coupling, and inconsistent at step 2 under the coupling fixed at the start. A dependence forming across the first step leaves the coupling fixed at the start consistent at every step, and the changing coupling inconsistent at step 3. (`Becoming.Changing.process`, `Becoming.Changing.run`, `Becoming.Changing.determined`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving`, `Becoming.Changing.forming`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolves`, `Becoming.Changing.forms`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving_not_admits_zero`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving_admits_succ`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving_consistent`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving_fixed_inconsistent`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_admits_zero`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_not_admits_one`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_admits_three`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_inconsistent`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_fixed_consistent`, `Becoming.Changing.forming_no_law`, `Becoming.Changing.dissolving_fixed_no_law`)
12. The image of a process through a projection represents every finite path exactly, in the sense of GenerativeCore's projection_exact_iff, exactly where configurations alike under it match each other's steps up to it; some determined process on the description admits every step read through it and lifts each of its steps from every configuration of the fibre exactly where configurations alike go alike and match. Going alike does not give matching (Stuck); Coarse is exact through its first bit. (`Becoming.MatchesThrough`, `Becoming.image_exact_iff`, `Becoming.exact_law_iff`, `Becoming.Stuck.process`, `Becoming.Stuck.goAlike_not_matches`, `Becoming.Coarse.matching`, `Becoming.Coarse.exact_law`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- None beyond the run, the projection and the step before which its steps are read; the witnesses are two-configuration processes. No axiom.
- For the backward direction, the relation is an equivalence; for coupling, the conditions are fixed (Conditions of Becoming.Renewal). The witness is a two-level process. No axiom.
- Dependences are read off the configuration (Dependence of Becoming.Dependence); what a formation observes is fixed. For the criterion, the relation is the coupling, an equivalence. The witness is a one-level process. No axiom.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which projection an actual unfolding carries a law through, or that any formation forms or uses one.
- A law means a determined process; undetermined and random laws along a run are not treated.
- The up-to form over histories (Web.AlikeThroughUpTo) relates two histories and is not the relation here.
- Observation that changes along the run is not treated; what a formation observes is fixed, as in Becoming.Testing.
- A dependence not read off the configuration (a Web whose requirements change with the step alone) is not treated here.
- Which formation's coupling carries a law along an actual unfolding, or how many steps settle it.
- The criterion along one run is near-definitional: what it adds is the least candidate, the persistence of failure, the identity instance, the bridges to coupling and the comparison of fixed and changing coupling.
- **Counterexample:** A run consistent where the process has no law: Constant (Constant.consistent, Constant.not_goAlike). Going alike without exactness: Stuck (Stuck.goAlike_not_matches). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LawAlongRun.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A determined process with no law at a formation's coupling along a run: Unseen (Unseen.determined, Unseen.no_law). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LawAlongRun.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Neither law gives the other where dependences change: Changing (dissolving_consistent with dissolving_fixed_inconsistent; forming_fixed_consistent with forming_inconsistent). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/LawAlongRun.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The chapter's open programme (section 8.2) named a constructive criterion along one run for a projection carrying a law, the bridge to GenerativeCore's exact projection, the instance with a formation's coupling as the relation, and the criterion through coupling that changes along the run; this record holds all four as one law under a relation with its readings, as the twentieth review's G4 asked. Coupling (Web.AlikeThrough) is a relation, not a projection, and an equality of what is coupled would need propext, so the law is stated up to an equivalence. Reading (the AI's): a run is evidence of a law under a relation exactly as far as its own steps agree; what it never visits it does not test; where what a formation does not couple into decides its next coupling, it meets no law at its coupling, only a record; a law at a description is not yet a faithful model of finite paths.
